channel.title: Almanac
channel.description: Almanac turns one source tree into documentation, a blog, and executed code output.

item.title: Announcing Almanac
item.description: A publishing framework for technical and scientific writing, where documentation, a blog, and executed code output all come from one source.

item.title: From a template to a framework
item.description: This project spent a while arguing that docs sites do not need a framework. Here is the argument, why it lost, and what changed as a result.

item.title: Documentation that runs its own examples
item.description: Why executable code blocks are the point of Almanac, how the cache decides when to re-run, and what every output on this page proves.

item.title: Everything you can put in a post
item.description: A working tour of every element a blog post can use (headings, code, tables, callouts, task lists, images), plus the components that show up on their own.
